title: Dead-code instructions
description: The instructions of the probe of the rules that ask what the change leaves behind. Beyond the review and its rules it is handed the dead-code facts, computed over the whole repository at the head commit, and the files they name. It judges those facts; it does not search for dead code

pullRequest.author: agent-rasmus[bot]
pullRequest.description: A published site is valid and its links hold. Verify runs html-validate and lychee.

rules.body: Delete [[Test]]s, [[Production code]], and [[Helper code]] that are no longer relevant or used.

principles.parent: Code is a liability, not an asset
principles.body: Always implement things when you actually need them, never when you just foresee that you need them.

rationales.id: Code is a liability, not an asset
rationales.body: Every line carries the ongoing cost of being read, supported, and updated, and is worth that cost only where it meets a user need.

definitions.specification: Code that runs a piece of the system and checks that it behaves as specified.
Code that executes in a deployment runtime after the build and serves [[Users]].
Small supporting code that exists to serve other code rather than a user-facing behaviour.
Whoever consumes the software or system to fulfill a need.

DeadCode.description: What the change leaves behind, by name: a mention is the name as a whole word in any text file

unusedDefinitions.description: Names the change defines that no file beyond the defining ones mentions

danglingReferences.description: Names whose definition the change removes while files still mention them

orphanedDefinitions.description: Names the change stops mentioning that are now mentioned nowhere beyond the files defining them: definitions the change made dead

Defined.description: A name and the files that define it

Used.description: A name whose definition is gone and the files that still mention it

DefinedName.description: A name the definition patterns recognise: a function, class, type, variable, shell function, or id
